key: AYA: ...
en: AYA: ...
ja: アヤ: ……

key: SAMSON: She's your friend, right?
en: SAMSON: She's your friend, right?
ja: サムソン: こいつ、お前の友達なんだろ?

key: RINGMASTER: Hey everyone! We've got another visitor!
en: RINGMASTER: Hey everyone! We've got another visitor!
ja: 団長: おーい、みんな! また新しいお客さんだぞ!

key: CAIN: Aya!
en: CAIN: Aya!
ja: カイン: アヤ!

key: RINGMASTER: By the way, is something up with Terra?
en: RINGMASTER: By the way, is something up with Terra?
ja: 団長: ところで、テラの様子がおかしくないか?

key: She just ran up, punched the community shower and then scampered off.
en: She just ran up, punched the community shower and then scampered off.
ja: さっき走ってきたと思ったら、共同シャワーを殴って、そのまま逃げてったぞ。

key: CAIN: Aya, can you hear me?
en: CAIN: Aya, can you hear me?
ja: カイン: アヤ、聞こえるか?

key: Are you okay? Please wake up!
en: Are you okay? Please wake up!
ja: 大丈夫か? 頼むから起きてくれ!

key: AYA: Unnh...
en: AYA: Unnh...
ja: アヤ: うぅん……

key: I feel like shit...
en: I feel like shit...
ja: 最悪な気分……

key: AYA: ...Cain?
en: AYA: ...Cain?
ja: アヤ: ……カイン?

key: CAIN: Oh, thank goodness!
en: CAIN: Oh, thank goodness!
ja: カイン: ああ、よかった!

key: AYA: Been a while...
en: AYA: Been a while...
ja: アヤ: 久しぶり……

key: CAIN: ...Yeaaaah...
en: CAIN: ...Yeaaaah...
ja: カイン: ……ああ……

key: ...Sorry about that.
en: ...Sorry about that.
ja: ……悪かったな。

key: I was, uh... busy.
en: I was, uh... busy.
ja: その、忙しかったんだ。

key: How's Mom?
en: How's Mom?
ja: 母さんは元気か?

key: AYA: Tch, don't ask.
en: AYA: Tch, don't ask.
ja: アヤ: チッ、聞くなよ。

key: Where's Hardy?
en: Where's Hardy?
ja: ハーディはどこ?

key: CIEL: Ah! That must be the other boy whom we observed soaring not-quite-so-elegantly over the Circus.
en: CIEL: Ah! That must be the other boy whom we observed soaring not-quite-so-elegantly over the Circus.
ja: シエル: あら! それって、サーカスの上をあまり優雅とは言えない感じで飛んでいた、あの男の子のことかしら。

key: AYA: Hardy was supposed to show me his Gym.
en: AYA: Hardy was supposed to show me his Gym.
ja: アヤ: ハーディが自分のジムを見せてくれるはずだったの。

key: That's why we went up to Agate, but...
en: That's why we went up to Agate, but...
ja: だからアゲートまで行ったんだけど……

key: I can't remember what happened when we got there.
en: I can't remember what happened when we got there.
ja: 着いてから何があったのか、思い出せなくて。

key: SAMSON: Somethin' in the city conked the both of you out.
en: SAMSON: Somethin' in the city conked the both of you out.
ja: サムソン: 街の中で何かが起きて、お前ら二人ともぶっ倒れたんだよ。

key: Affects everyone in there.
en: Affects everyone in there.
ja: 中にいる人間、全員に効くみたいだ。

key: That's why the whole place has been closed off for who knows how long by now.
en: That's why the whole place has been closed off for who knows how long by now.
ja: だから街全体がずっと封鎖されたままなんだ。

key: CAIN: We found you sleeping in the middle of the street.
en: CAIN: We found you sleeping in the middle of the street.
ja: カイン: 道の真ん中で眠ってるところを見つけたんだ。

key: SAMSON: Speaking of that, boss--
en: SAMSON: Speaking of that, boss--
ja: サムソン: そういえば、団長――

key: There any word on that sitch?
en: There any word on that sitch?
ja: あの件、なんか情報は入ってきてないのか?

key: RINGMASTER: We did get some information, actually, but...
en: RINGMASTER: We did get some information, actually, but...
ja: 団長: 実は、いくつか情報は入ってきてるんだが……

key: It's probably best not to trouble our guests with it.
en: It's probably best not to trouble our guests with it.
ja: お客さんたちを煩わせるようなことでもないだろう。

key: The only point of concern is that this sleeping ordeal has been cast over the entire city.
en: The only point of concern is that this sleeping ordeal has been cast over the entire city.
ja: 気になるのは、この眠りの災難が街全体にかけられてるってことくらいだ。

key: CAIN: I almost fell victim to it too, but then Terra happened.
en: CAIN: I almost fell victim to it too, but then Terra happened.
ja: カイン: 俺も危うくやられるところだったんだけど、そこにテラが来てさ。

key: CIEL: Apologies for her.
en: CIEL: Apologies for her.
ja: シエル: 彼女のこと、申し訳なく思ってますわ。

key: RINGMASTER: Ahah, she may be rambunctious, but we do have to keep her around!
en: RINGMASTER: Ahah, she may be rambunctious, but we do have to keep her around!
ja: 団長: あはは、あいつは暴れん坊だが、手放すわけにはいかないからな!

key: After all, it wouldn't do for the Agate Circus to lose one of its famous Gym Leaders!
en: After all, it wouldn't do for the Agate Circus to lose one of its famous Gym Leaders!
ja: アゲートサーカスの看板ジムリーダーを失うわけにはいかないだろう!

key: CIEL: True, we wouldn't be the Agate Ace Triumvirate without her.
en: CIEL: True, we wouldn't be the Agate Ace Triumvirate without her.
ja: シエル: たしかに、彼女がいなければアゲート三強とは呼べませんものね。

key: Unfortunately.
en: Unfortunately.
ja: 残念ながら。

key: RINGMASTER: That's right! The Gym Battles make fantastic shows!
en: RINGMASTER: That's right! The Gym Battles make fantastic shows!
ja: 団長: そのとおり! ジムバトルは最高のショーになるからな!

key: CIEL: Flying-type Leader, at your service~
en: CIEL: Flying-type Leader, at your service~
ja: シエル: ひこうタイプのリーダー、お呼びとあらば参上ですわ～

key: RINGMASTER: Terra is the Ground-type Leader, and Samson has the Fighting-type!
en: RINGMASTER: Terra is the Ground-type Leader, and Samson has the Fighting-type!
ja: 団長: テラはじめんタイプのリーダー、そしてサムソンはかくとうタイプだ!

key: SAMSON: Sup.
en: SAMSON: Sup.
ja: サムソン: よう。

key: AYA: So... Hardy isn't here?
en: AYA: So... Hardy isn't here?
ja: アヤ: つまり……ハーディはここにいないの?

key: RINGMASTER: I'm afraid not.
en: RINGMASTER: I'm afraid not.
ja: 団長: 残念だが、いないな。

key: He probably fell somewhere in Route 2.
en: He probably fell somewhere in Route 2.
ja: おそらく2番道路のどこかで倒れてるんじゃないか。

key: AYA: Then... we need to go find him, right?
en: AYA: Then... we need to go find him, right?
ja: アヤ: なら……探しに行かないと、だよね?

key: CAIN: You really seem to like this guy, huh?
en: CAIN: You really seem to like this guy, huh?
ja: カイン: お前、そいつのことけっこう気に入ってるんだな?

key: AYA: What?
en: AYA: What?
ja: アヤ: 何?

key: N-no!
en: N-no!
ja: ち、違う!

key: It's not like that.
en: It's not like that.
ja: そういうんじゃないから。

key: I'm just worried.
en: I'm just worried.
ja: ただ心配なだけ。

key: That's all.
en: That's all.
ja: それだけ。

key: And I know he would do the same for us.
en: And I know he would do the same for us.
ja: それに、あいつだって同じことしてくれるはずだし。

key: So... we should go.
en: So... we should go.
ja: だから……行かなきゃ。

key: SAMSON: Negative, little lady.
en: SAMSON: Negative, little lady.
ja: サムソン: ダメだ、お嬢ちゃん。

key: You're staying right there.
en: You're staying right there.
ja: お前はそこでじっとしてろ。

key: I'm surprised you can even walk after what Terra put you through.
en: I'm surprised you can even walk after what Terra put you through.
ja: テラにあんな目に遭わされて、よく歩けるもんだと感心するぜ。

key: CIEL: I'm afraid I must agree.
en: CIEL: I'm afraid I must agree.
ja: シエル: わたしも同意せざるを得ませんわ。

key: It won't do at all to send you in your condition.
en: It won't do at all to send you in your condition.
ja: その状態で行かせるわけにはいきませんもの。

key: CAIN: \PN, would you mind going to look for Hardy?
en: CAIN: \PN, would you mind going to look for Hardy?
ja: カイン: \PN、ハーディを探しに行ってもらってもいいか?

key: I kinda wanna catch up with Aya for a little.
en: I kinda wanna catch up with Aya for a little.
ja: 俺はちょっとアヤと積もる話がしたくてさ。

key: AYA: Now?
en: AYA: Now?
ja: アヤ: 今?

key: After everything?
en: After everything?
ja: こんなことがあった後で?

key: CAIN: ...Look, I can... explain,
en: CAIN: ...Look, I can... explain,
ja: カイン: ……なあ、説明……できると思う、

key: Kind of,
en: Kind of,
ja: 一応な、

key: But I never wanted to leave you alone there.
en: But I never wanted to leave you alone there.
ja: でも、お前を一人にするつもりなんて一度もなかったんだ。

key: I just couldn't stay.
en: I just couldn't stay.
ja: ただ、あそこにはいられなかった。

key: That's all the more reason I owe it to you to get back on track now, right?
en: That's all the more reason I owe it to you to get back on track now, right?
ja: だからこそ、今きちんと向き合う義理があるだろ?

key: AYA: ...Whatever.
en: AYA: ...Whatever.
ja: アヤ: ……もういい。

key: RINGMASTER: Oh! Hmm, if \PN is going out searching...
en: RINGMASTER: Oh! Hmm, if \PN is going out searching...
ja: 団長: おっと! \PNが探しに行くってなら……

key: Then I believe a change of plans is in order!
en: Then I believe a change of plans is in order!
ja: 予定を変更したほうがよさそうだな!

key: RINGMASTER: I mentioned that intel about Agate before, right?
en: RINGMASTER: I mentioned that intel about Agate before, right?
ja: 団長: さっきアゲートの情報がどうとか言ってたよな?

key: Perhaps you can be of help to us.
en: Perhaps you can be of help to us.
ja: お前さんに手を貸してもらえるかもしれない。

key: We had already suspected as much, but we just confirmed that this whole sleeping spell is most definitely caused by that terrorist group, Team Meteor.
en: We had already suspected as much, but we just confirmed that this whole sleeping spell is most definitely caused by that terrorist group, Team Meteor.
ja: 薄々感づいてはいたんだが、この眠りの呪いが、あのテロ組織――チームメテオの仕業だってことが確認できたんだ。

key: We got a tip-- someone from the inside-- who confirmed it for us.
en: We got a tip-- someone from the inside-- who confirmed it for us.
ja: 内部の人間から密告があってな――それで確かめられたんだ。

key: SAMSON: You sure they aren't leading us on?
en: SAMSON: You sure they aren't leading us on?
ja: サムソン: そいつに担がれてるってことはないのか?

key: RINGMASTER: I asked the caller that as well...
en: RINGMASTER: I asked the caller that as well...
ja: 団長: 電話の相手にもそう聞いたんだが……

key: They assured me, in a very flowery and over-elaborate voice, that they were just looking out for their own interests.
en: They assured me, in a very flowery and over-elaborate voice, that they were just looking out for their own interests.
ja: 自分はただ自分の利益のために動いてるだけだと、やたら回りくどくて大げさな話し方で保証してきたよ。

key: Come to think of it, their pattern of speech was somewhat familiar...
en: Come to think of it, their pattern of speech was somewhat familiar...
ja: 考えてみりゃ、その話し方、どこか聞き覚えがあった気がするんだよな……

key: Oh, maybe because it reminds me of the way you talk, Ciel.
en: Oh, maybe because it reminds me of the way you talk, Ciel.
ja: ああ、もしかしたらシエル、お前の話し方に似てたからかもな。

key: CIEL: I-- ???
en: CIEL: I-- ???
ja: シエル: わたし――???

key: I haven't the foggiest what you could mean by that.
en: I haven't the foggiest what you could mean by that.
ja: 何のことだか、さっぱりわかりませんわ。

key: RINGMASTER: Yeah, like that.
en: RINGMASTER: Yeah, like that.
ja: 団長: ああ、そうそう、その話し方だ。

key: Anyway, they also suggested that the person responsible for the issue was not too far from here, and goes by the name Titawin, or "T".
en: Anyway, they also suggested that the person responsible for the issue was not too far from here, and goes by the name Titawin, or "T".
ja: とにかく、この件の張本人はここからそう遠くない場所にいて、ティタウィン、あるいは『T』と名乗ってるらしい。

key: SAMSON: What kind of name is Titawin?
en: SAMSON: What kind of name is Titawin?
ja: サムソン: ティタウィンって、なんつー名前だよ。

key: RINGMASTER: Maybe a codename.
en: RINGMASTER: Maybe a codename.
ja: 団長: たぶんコードネームだろうな。

key: Or, I don't know; your guess is as good as mine,
en: Or, I don't know; your guess is as good as mine,
ja: まあ、俺にもよくわからん、お前の勘と大差ないさ、

key: But it may not be as good as someone else's.
en: But it may not be as good as someone else's.
ja: だが、他の誰かの勘のほうが当たってるかもな。

key: There's another Gym Leader who lives not too far from here-- out by the cascade on Route 2--
en: There's another Gym Leader who lives not too far from here-- out by the cascade on Route 2--
ja: ここからそう遠くないところに、もう一人ジムリーダーが住んでるんだ――2番道路の滝の近くにな――

key: And I understand she was digging into Team Meteor at some point in the past.
en: And I understand she was digging into Team Meteor at some point in the past.
ja: 彼女は以前、チームメテオのことを調べてたって聞いてる。

key: I believe her name is...
en: I believe her name is...
ja: たしか名前は……

key: Amaria Fiore.
en: Amaria Fiore.
ja: アマリア・フィオーレ。

key: \PN, if you have to search out in that direction anyway, maybe you could check in with her and see if we could all trade notes?
en: \PN, if you have to search out in that direction anyway, maybe you could check in with her and see if we could all trade notes?
ja: \PN、どうせそっちの方向を探しに行くなら、彼女のところに寄って、情報交換できないか聞いてみてくれないか?

key: Ah, and you might find this useful.
en: Ah, and you might find this useful.
ja: ああ、それとこれが役に立つかもしれないぞ。

key: RINGMASTER: That Powder Vial will be useful for getting through Route 2.
en: RINGMASTER: That Powder Vial will be useful for getting through Route 2.
ja: 団長: そのこなのビンは、2番道路を通り抜けるのに役立つはずだ。

key: You can ask the rangers in the west gate how to use it.
en: You can ask the rangers in the west gate how to use it.
ja: 使い方は西門のレンジャーに聞くといい。

key: AYA: Just don't forget about Hardy, okay?
en: AYA: Just don't forget about Hardy, okay?
ja: アヤ: ハーディのこと、忘れないでよね?

key: Um, not that I miss him or anything...
en: Um, not that I miss him or anything...
ja: べ、別に会いたいとか、そういうんじゃないけど……

key: RINGMASTER: Best of luck, \PN, and we'll be waiting to hear back~
en: RINGMASTER: Best of luck, \PN, and we'll be waiting to hear back~
ja: 団長: 頑張ってこいよ、\PN、報告を待ってるぞ～

key: CAIN: Soooo, this Hardy guy...
en: CAIN: Soooo, this Hardy guy...
ja: カイン: それでさ、そのハーディってやつ……

key: AYA: I know what you're going to say, and you may as well just not say it.
en: AYA: I know what you're going to say, and you may as well just not say it.
ja: アヤ: 何言おうとしてるかわかってるから、言わなくていいよ。

key: CAIN: Pshaw, don't be like that.
en: CAIN: Pshaw, don't be like that.
ja: カイン: ちぇっ、そんなこと言うなよ。

key: Tell me about him.
en: Tell me about him.
ja: そいつのこと、教えてくれよ。

key: After all, I'm gonna need to know who to beat up if he hurts you.
en: After all, I'm gonna need to know who to beat up if he hurts you.
ja: だってさ、そいつがお前を傷つけたら、誰をぶちのめせばいいか知っとかないと。

key: That's what brothers are supposed to do, right?
en: That's what brothers are supposed to do, right?
ja: それが兄貴ってもんだろ?

key: AYA: Brothers also aren't supposed to run away from home.
en: AYA: Brothers also aren't supposed to run away from home.
ja: アヤ: 兄貴は家出もしないもんだけどね。

key: CAIN: Ouch.
en: CAIN: Ouch.
ja: カイン: 痛いとこ突くな。

key: AYA: He's the Agate City Rock Leader.
en: AYA: He's the Agate City Rock Leader.
ja: アヤ: アゲートシティのいわタイプリーダーだよ。

key: He came down to help me settle into my own job--
en: He came down to help me settle into my own job--
ja: わたしが仕事に慣れるのを手伝いに来てくれたの――

key: You know, the one you totally dumped on me.
en: You know, the one you totally dumped on me.
ja: そう、あんたが丸投げしてきた仕事のこと。

key: CAIN: Okay, okay, I get it!
en: CAIN: Okay, okay, I get it!
ja: カイン: わかった、わかったって!

key: I'm sorry.
en: I'm sorry.
ja: 悪かったよ。

key: Put your claws away.
en: Put your claws away.
ja: 爪をしまってくれ。

key: AYA: We were working on figuring out what kind of puzzle my Gym should have.
en: AYA: We were working on figuring out what kind of puzzle my Gym should have.
ja: アヤ: わたしのジムにどんな謎解きを置くか、二人で考えてたの。

key: Because, I guess every Gym has to have a puzzle.
en: Because, I guess every Gym has to have a puzzle.
ja: だって、どのジムにも謎解きが必要みたいだから。

key: Is that strange?
en: Is that strange?
ja: 変かな?

key: Anyway, he said he'd take me up and show me his Gym's puzzle as an example.
en: Anyway, he said he'd take me up and show me his Gym's puzzle as an example.
ja: とにかく、例として自分のジムの謎解きを見せてくれるって言ってくれて。

key: I guess it's based on sound and music?
en: I guess it's based on sound and music?
ja: 音とか音楽がテーマみたい?

key: And... then this happened.
en: And... then this happened.
ja: それで……こうなったの。

key: CAIN: You still haven't actually told me anything about him though.
en: CAIN: You still haven't actually told me anything about him though.
ja: カイン: でも、まだそいつのこと全然話してもらってないぞ。

key: Is he cute?
en: Is he cute?
ja: かわいい系?

key: AYA: I mean, he--
en: AYA: I mean, he--
ja: アヤ: その、彼は――

key: What kind of question is that?!
en: What kind of question is that?!
ja: 何その質問!?

key: CAIN: Ahaha~ So he is!
en: CAIN: Ahaha~ So he is!
ja: カイン: あはは～ やっぱりそうなんだ!

key: AYA: I didn't say that!
en: AYA: I didn't say that!
ja: アヤ: そんなこと言ってない!

key: CAIN: You didn't deny it.
en: CAIN: You didn't deny it.
ja: カイン: 否定もしてないけどな。

key: AYA: That doesn't mean it's true!
en: AYA: That doesn't mean it's true!
ja: アヤ: だからって本当とは限らないでしょ!

key: CAIN: Is it true?
en: CAIN: Is it true?
ja: カイン: で、本当なのか?

key: AYA: That-- I--
en: AYA: That-- I--
ja: アヤ: それは――わたし――

key: ...Maybe.
en: ...Maybe.
ja: ……かもね。

key: CAIN: Use protection.
en: CAIN: Use protection.
ja: カイン: ちゃんと気をつけろよ。

key: AYA: WHAT?!
en: AYA: WHAT?!
ja: アヤ: なんですって?!

key: AYA: Since Agate City is closed, what should we do now?
en: AYA: Since Agate City is closed, what should we do now?
ja: アヤ: アゲートシティが閉鎖されてるなら、これからどうすればいいの?

key: HARDY: There's some crazy stuff going on in Calcenon.
en: HARDY: There's some crazy stuff going on in Calcenon.
ja: ハーディ: カルセノンで何かヤバいことが起きてるみたいだぜ。

key: Imma go check it out.
en: Imma go check it out.
ja: ちょっと見に行ってくるかな。

key: Once my entire body stops aching, anyway...
en: Once my entire body stops aching, anyway...
ja: 全身の痛みが引いたらの話だけど……

key: I feel like I got run over by a herd of Bouffalant.
en: I feel like I got run over by a herd of Bouffalant.
ja: バッフロンの群れにひかれた気分だぜ。

key: CAIN: Terra treated you like a croquet ball.
en: CAIN: Terra treated you like a croquet ball.
ja: カイン: テラにクロッケーの球みたいに扱われてたもんな。

key: So, close enough.
en: So, close enough.
ja: まあ、大差ないさ。

key: I mean, I'm surprised you guys even survived.
en: I mean, I'm surprised you guys even survived.
ja: つーか、よく生きてたなって驚いてるくらいだよ。

key: AYA: Disappointed?
en: AYA: Disappointed?
ja: アヤ: がっかりした?

key: CAIN: Nah~
en: CAIN: Nah~
ja: カイン: いやいや～

key: HARDY: Haha, gonna take more than that to break us down.
en: HARDY: Haha, gonna take more than that to break us down.
ja: ハーディ: はは、あれくらいじゃ俺たちは倒れないぜ。

key: You were hurt too, huh, Aya?
en: You were hurt too, huh, Aya?
ja: アヤ、お前もやられたんだろ?

key: AYA: I think I took an Earthquake to the face.
en: AYA: I think I took an Earthquake to the face.
ja: アヤ: 顔面に『じしん』を食らった気がする。

key: CAIN: You know she almost flattened me, too.

en: Unlike Samson's all-out offense, Ciel plays more defensively.
ja: サムソンの全力攻撃と違って、シエルはもっと守りを重視するタイプだよ。

key: Many of her Pokémon have bulky set-ups, so they can be hard to power down.
en: Many of her Pokémon have bulky set-ups, so they can be hard to power down.
ja: 彼女のポケモンはタフな型が多いから、削り切るのが大変なんだ。

key: But, Ciel is a performer at heart, and it shows in her battles, as she prefers to use dancing and sound- based moves.
en: But, Ciel is a performer at heart, and it shows in her battles, as she prefers to use dancing and sound- based moves.
ja: でも、シエルは根っからのパフォーマーだから、それが戦い方にも出てて、ダンスや音を使うわざを好んで使うよ。

key: And being in an arena, it's the perfect place for those things to get her going.
en: And being in an arena, it's the perfect place for those things to get her going.
ja: アリーナっていう場所は、そういうわざを活かすのにぴったりなんだ。

key: If you can set up and knock her down before she even gets in the air, you should do well!
en: If you can set up and knock her down before she even gets in the air, you should do well!
ja: 彼女が宙に浮く前に態勢を整えてたたければ、有利に進められるはずだよ!

key: But if she gets her act in the air, it's gonna be a long way down for you.
en: But if she gets her act in the air, it's gonna be a long way down for you.
ja: でも、いったん彼女が空中でショーを始めたら、こっちは奈落の底行きだからね。

key: CIEL: Shall we dance?
en: CIEL: Shall we dance?
ja: シエル: 踊っていただけますかしら?

key: CIEL: Right, show me everything you've got!
en: CIEL: Right, show me everything you've got!
ja: シエル: さあ、あなたの持てるすべてを見せてくださいまし!

key: CIEL: Take your time, darling. I want your best performance!
en: CIEL: Take your time, darling. I want your best performance!
ja: シエル: 焦らなくていいですわ、あなた。最高のパフォーマンスを期待してますの!

key: RINGMASTER: All right, that was very well done, both of you!
en: RINGMASTER: All right, that was very well done, both of you!
ja: 団長: よし、二人ともお見事だったぞ!

key: CIEL: Naturally~
en: CIEL: Naturally~
ja: シエル: 当然ですわ～

key: RINGMASTER: BUT.
en: RINGMASTER: BUT.
ja: 団長: だがな。

key: No more stunts like that in the future, Ciel.
en: No more stunts like that in the future, Ciel.
ja: 今後は、ああいう危ない真似はもうやめとけよ、シエル。

key: CIEL: Who, me?
en: CIEL: Who, me?
ja: シエル: あら、わたしのこと?

key: I haven't a clue what you might be referring to.
en: I haven't a clue what you might be referring to.
ja: 何のことだか、さっぱり見当もつきませんわ。

key: RINGMASTER: The only reason I went with it is because we ARE short on performances with Terra gone.
en: RINGMASTER: The only reason I went with it is because we ARE short on performances with Terra gone.
ja: 団長: 見逃したのは、テラがいなくてショーが足りてないってだけの理由だからな。

key: CIEL: Thank you for your benevolence and mercy, young master~
en: CIEL: Thank you for your benevolence and mercy, young master~
ja: シエル: あなたの慈悲深いご厚意に感謝いたしますわ、若様～

key: RINGMASTER: "Young master"?
en: RINGMASTER: "Young master"?
ja: 団長: 「若様」?

key: Go back to sassing each other.
en: Go back to sassing each other.
ja: お前らはまた減らず口をたたき合ってろ。

key: I've got a closing ceremony to do!
en: I've got a closing ceremony to do!
ja: 俺は閉会の挨拶があるんだ!

key: SAMSON: Nice.
en: SAMSON: Nice.
ja: サムソン: いいじゃん。

key: CIEL: I don't want to hear it!
en: CIEL: I don't want to hear it!
ja: シエル: あなたには言われたくありませんわ!

key: My battle was better than yours.
en: My battle was better than yours.
ja: わたしの試合のほうが、あなたのより見応えがありましたもの。

key: So ha-ha~
en: So ha-ha~
ja: だからいい気味ですわ～

key: SAMSON: Whatever you say, lass.
en: SAMSON: Whatever you say, lass.
ja: サムソン: はいはい、そういうことにしといてやるよ、お嬢さん。

key: I think we can agree that both of our battles beat getting lost in a digital void.
en: I think we can agree that both of our battles beat getting lost in a digital void.
ja: とりあえず、デジタル空間で迷子になるよりは、俺たちの試合のほうがマシだったってことは、お互い認められるだろ。

key: I'm not really in the mood to banter though, so I'm gonna go blow off some steam.
en: I'm not really in the mood to banter though, so I'm gonna go blow off some steam.
ja: 軽口をたたく気分でもないから、ちょっと発散してくるわ。

key: Ciao.
en: Ciao.
ja: じゃあな。

key: CIEL: Hmm...
en: CIEL: Hmm...
ja: シエル: ふぅ……

key: I suppose you have business too, don't you?
en: I suppose you have business too, don't you?
ja: あなたにも用事があるのでしょう?

key: It's been quiet here lately.
en: It's been quiet here lately.
ja: 最近、ここは静かになりましたわね。

key: CIEL: But I suppose it's to be expected.
en: CIEL: But I suppose it's to be expected.
ja: シエル: でも、当然のことなのでしょうね。

key: What is it they say?
en: What is it they say?
ja: よく言うでしょう?

key: It's lonely at the top.
en: It's lonely at the top.
ja: 頂点に立つ者は孤独だと。

key: ...Or, perhaps,
en: ...Or, perhaps,
ja: ……いえ、それとも、

key: They only say that because they've already pushed everyone who cared for them away.
en: They only say that because they've already pushed everyone who cared for them away.
ja: 気にかけてくれる人たちをすでに全員遠ざけてしまったから、そう言うだけなのかしら。

key: Well, Samson is so easy to bully, one can hardly be blamed for it, right?
en: Well, Samson is so easy to bully, one can hardly be blamed for it, right?
ja: まあ、サムソンはいじりやすすぎますから、責められるようなことでもありませんわよね?

key: And that's kind of our thing.
en: And that's kind of our thing.
ja: それがわたしたちらしさ、みたいなところもありますし。

key: Terra...
en: Terra...
ja: テラは……

key: Well, she has her moments, I suppose.
en: Well, she has her moments, I suppose.
ja: まあ、彼女にも見どころはあると思いますわ。

key: When she isn't stabbing us in our proverbial backs, that is.
en: When she isn't stabbing us in our proverbial backs, that is.
ja: こちらの背中を刺していないときに限りますけれど。

key: There was another, you know.
en: There was another, you know.
ja: 他にもいましたのよ。

key: They came out here not long after I did, and brought their own act.
en: They came out here not long after I did, and brought their own act.
ja: わたしが来てからそう経たないうちに、ここへやってきて、自分の出し物を持ち込んだんですの。

key: And I think they expected more from me than I could give.
en: And I think they expected more from me than I could give.
ja: わたしに期待していたものは、わたしが差し出せるもの以上だったのでしょうね。

key: It was my cousin.
en: It was my cousin.
ja: わたしの従姉妹でしたの。

key: But I was afraid that if I let the pieces of my old life trail behind me, they would drag me down.
en: But I was afraid that if I let the pieces of my old life trail behind me, they would drag me down.
ja: でも、昔の生活の残りを引きずったままだと、足を引っ張られてしまうのが怖かったんですの。

key: I was, perhaps, callous.
en: I was, perhaps, callous.
ja: わたしは、たぶん、冷たかったのでしょうね。

key: I suddenly feel as if I owe them an apology.
en: I suddenly feel as if I owe them an apology.
ja: 急に、あの人に謝らなくてはという気持ちになってきましたわ。

key: Maybe I shall attempt to reach out to them...
en: Maybe I shall attempt to reach out to them...
ja: 連絡を取ってみようかしら……

key: CIEL: Ah, but enough of you lingering just to hear me drivel on.
en: CIEL: Ah, but enough of you lingering just to hear me drivel on.
ja: シエル: ああ、でも、わたしの繰り言を聞くためだけに、あなたを引き止めるのはこのくらいにしておきますわ。

key: You intend to go back to the city, don't you?
en: You intend to go back to the city, don't you?
ja: 街に戻るおつもりなのでしょう?

key: Best of luck, wherever you go, \PN.
en: Best of luck, wherever you go, \PN.
ja: どこへ行くにしても、幸運を祈ってますわ、\PN。

key: SAMSON: I'm on cleaning duty for a month.
en: SAMSON: I'm on cleaning duty for a month.
ja: サムソン: 一ヶ月間、掃除当番になっちまった。

key: Trashed the changing room.
en: Trashed the changing room.
ja: 更衣室をぶっ壊したんだ。

key: Had to.
en: Had to.
ja: しょうがなかったんだよ。

key: At first it was just Ciel's cabinet.
en: At first it was just Ciel's cabinet.
ja: 最初はシエルのロッカーだけだったんだ。

key: Then it was Terra's.
en: Then it was Terra's.
ja: それからテラのロッカーもな。

key: Bunch of fucking rubber Torchic in there.
en: Bunch of fucking rubber Torchic in there.
ja: 中にクソみたいなアチャモのゴム人形がぎっしり入っててよ。

key: They scream bloody murder.
en: They scream bloody murder.
ja: あいつら、鳴らすと悲鳴みたいな音が出るんだ。

key: Laughed so hard I fell over and passed out.
en: Laughed so hard I fell over and passed out.
ja: 笑いすぎて倒れて気絶しちまった。

key: That's one way to get caught red-handed.
en: That's one way to get caught red-handed.
ja: それで見事に現行犯ってわけだ。

key: Even when she's been gone for so long, that wench still causes trouble for me.
en: Even when she's been gone for so long, that wench still causes trouble for me.
ja: あんなに長くいなくなってても、あの女はまだ俺に面倒事を残していきやがる。

key: You know, she's the only reason I was in the Triumvirate in the first place.
en: You know, she's the only reason I was in the Triumvirate in the first place.
ja: そもそも俺が三強に入ったのは、あいつのせいなんだよな。

key: I'd been in the Circus for a while.
en: I'd been in the Circus for a while.
ja: サーカスにはしばらく前からいたんだ。

key: My old man was a fan of corporal punishment.
en: My old man was a fan of corporal punishment.
ja: うちの親父は体罰が大好きな男でな。

key: I wasn't.
en: I wasn't.
ja: 俺のほうはそうじゃなかった。

key: But eventually boys get bigger than their fathers.
en: But eventually boys get bigger than their fathers.
ja: でも、いずれ息子は親父よりでかくなるもんだ。

key: That bit him in the ass.
en: That bit him in the ass.
ja: それが親父にとって痛い目を見る羽目になった。

key: Got kicked to the street; found a life here.
en: Got kicked to the street; found a life here.
ja: 街に放り出されて、ここで生きる道を見つけたんだ。

key: Then that chick showed up one day and insisted on being a lion tamer of all things.
en: Then that chick showed up one day and insisted on being a lion tamer of all things.
ja: そしたらある日、あの女が現れて、よりによってライオン使いになるって言い張ってな。

key: We made her a clown.
en: We made her a clown.
ja: 結局、俺たちはあいつをピエロにしたんだ。

key: She dyed her hair.
en: She dyed her hair.
ja: 髪を染めてな。

key: Could've just worn a wig, but, nope.
en: Could've just worn a wig, but, nope.
ja: かつらでもかぶりゃよかったのに、しなかった。

key: That would've been practical.
en: That would've been practical.
ja: そのほうが現実的だったろうによ。

key: That ain't her style.
en: That ain't her style.
ja: でも、それはあいつのやり方じゃねえんだ。

key: She always got on my nerves, and was all too happy to do so.
en: She always got on my nerves, and was all too happy to do so.
ja: いつも俺の神経を逆なでしてきて、しかもそれを心底楽しんでやがった。

key: She knew I had eyes for Ciel.
en: She knew I had eyes for Ciel.
ja: 俺がシエルに気があるのを知っててな。

key: With a lady like that, who can blame a man?
en: With a lady like that, who can blame a man?
ja: あんな女に、ほれない男がいるかよ。

key: I think she started flirting with her just to make me jealous.
en: I think she started flirting with her just to make me jealous.
ja: あいつ、俺をやきもきさせるためにシエルに言い寄り始めたんだと思う。

key: Eventually it came to a bet.
en: Eventually it came to a bet.
ja: 結局、それが賭けにまで発展してな。

key: Six on six.
en: Six on six.

key: Winner asked her out first.
en: Winner asked her out first.
ja: 勝った方が先にシエルを誘えるってルールでな。

key: And if Terra had lost, she'd have left the Circus.
en: And if Terra had lost, she'd have left the Circus.
ja: テラが負けたら、サーカスを去るって話だった。

key: If I had lost, I would've done whatever she wanted.
en: If I had lost, I would've done whatever she wanted.
ja: 俺が負けたら、あいつの言うことを何でも聞くって話でな。

key: She wanted me to register as a Leader with her.
en: She wanted me to register as a Leader with her.
ja: あいつは俺に、一緒にリーダー登録しろって言ってきたんだ。

key: Only got the reserve spot for my type, but that was enough to get us into some extra limelight for shows.
en: Only got the reserve spot for my type, but that was enough to get us into some extra limelight for shows.
ja: 俺のタイプは補欠枠にしかなれなかったが、それでもショーで多少目立てるくらいにはなったな。

key: Enough to get us more time around Ciel.
en: Enough to get us more time around Ciel.
ja: シエルと過ごす時間を増やすには十分だった。

key: And more rejections apiece.
en: And more rejections apiece.
ja: その分、二人とも振られる回数も増えたけどな。

key: But thinking about it...
en: But thinking about it...
ja: でも、こうして考えてみると……

key: I'm glad it didn't go down any other way.
en: I'm glad it didn't go down any other way.
ja: 他の結末にならなくてよかったと思ってる。

key: I don't have a fucking clue what to do, \PN.
en: I don't have a fucking clue what to do, \PN.
ja: どうすりゃいいのか、俺にはまったく分からねえよ、\PN。

key: I learned from my old man that getting back at someone never makes anything better.
en: I learned from my old man that getting back at someone never makes anything better.
ja: 親父を見て学んだんだ、仕返しなんかしても何も良くならねえって。

key: But I can't shake this anger.
en: But I can't shake this anger.
ja: でも、この怒りを振り払えねえんだ。

key: It's quiet by now, but it's there.
en: It's quiet by now, but it's there.
ja: 今は静かになってるが、確かにそこにある。

key: It doesn't leave, no matter what I take it out on.
en: It doesn't leave, no matter what I take it out on.
ja: 何にぶつけても、消えてなくなりはしねえ。

key: I can barely breathe,
en: I can barely breathe,
ja: 息すらまともにできねえ、

key: Like a vat of lava being poured down my throat,
en: Like a vat of lava being poured down my throat,
ja: 喉に溶岩を流し込まれてるみたいに、

key: Fire in my fucking bloodstream,
en: Fire in my fucking bloodstream,
ja: 血の中を火が駆け巡ってやがる、

key: Eventually it just settles into stone.
en: Eventually it just settles into stone.
ja: そのうち、それも石みたいに固まっちまうんだ。

key: A weight in my core.
en: A weight in my core.
ja: 腹の底に重石があるみたいでよ。

key: Hard to walk. Hard to think.
en: Hard to walk. Hard to think.
ja: 歩くのもつらい。考えるのもつらい。

key: And I'm sure it's not half as bad as whatever's happened to Ciel.
en: And I'm sure it's not half as bad as whatever's happened to Ciel.
ja: それでも、シエルに起きたことに比べりゃ、半分もひどくねえんだろうけどな。

key: SAMSON: If I stay around here, I'll break something, or someone.
en: SAMSON: If I stay around here, I'll break something, or someone.
ja: サムソン: ここにこれ以上いたら、何かか、誰かを壊しちまう。

key: See you around.
en: See you around.
ja: またな。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
